A CONVERSATION WITH FI

Let’s hear from you.

For buyers
Ask about a product, its specifications, warehouse inspection or your order. Include a product name or order reference when you have one.

For suppliers
Introduce your company, country of manufacture and product range. A website or catalogue link helps us understand your work.

For applicants
Choose a position and tell us what you would bring to FI. A CV or portfolio link is welcome. Applications go privately to our team for review; submitting one does not create an account or confirm a role.

One of the founders will reply, usually within 48 hours. Supplier introductions are reviewed before products can join our collection.
